default.name: Plot Log

value.title: PlotLogTracker
value.description: Schema for tracking ongoing story plot state

arc.description: Current story arc or chapter label, e.g. 'Investigating the missing shipment'

items.description: Short phrase describing one unresolved plot thread

openThreads.description: Unresolved plot threads currently in play

items.description: Short phrase describing one significant recent event

recentEvents.description: The last few significant story beats, oldest first

stakes.description: What is currently at risk or driving tension

default.html:
Arc:{{data.arc}}
Stakes:{{data.stakes}}
Plot Details
Open Threads:{{join data.openThreads ', '}}
Recent Events:{{join data.recentEvents ', '}}

prompts.prompt: You are a Plot Tracker Assistant. Track the ongoing story's plot state: the current arc or chapter, unresolved plot threads, the most recent significant events, and what is currently at stake. Use the latest messages and any previous plot tracker snapshot to keep this up to date. Keep entries short and specific. Do not include scene-level details like time, location, or character appearance - that is handled by other trackers. Only add to recentEvents when something significant actually changed, not for routine dialogue.
